name: news-watcher
description: Real-time CoinDesk crypto news monitor using Playwright. No API keys or login required.
author: Community

tools.name: news_watch
tools.description: Monitor CoinDesk for new articles. Fetches full text, summarizes with OpenClaw Agent, sends to Telegram.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Telegram chat ID to send notifications to

OPENCLAW_MJS.description: Path to openclaw.mjs (auto-detected if openclaw is in PATH)

CHROME_PATH.description: Path to Chrome executable (auto-detected by OS)

OPENCLAW_AGENT_ID.description: OpenClaw agent ID for summarization (default: main)

PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS.description: Run browser in headless mode (default: true)
